How It Works

From Your Memories To Their Smile.

Four simple steps between a feeling and an unforgettable surprise.

01

Share Your Story

Tell us about the person, occasion, memories, feelings and special moments.

02

Send Your Memories

Share your photos, messages, audio, video, poems and other special memories according to your selected plan.

03

We Create The Magic

Our team transforms your memories into a beautiful personalized digital experience.

04

Scan • Surprise • Smile

We deliver your personalized website as a QR code. Share it with the person you love and watch their reaction.

A Story

Imagine This...

Mani and Kalaay are in love.

Kalaay's birthday is coming. Mani wants to give her something more meaningful than an ordinary gift.

So Mani contacts Your Thoughts.

He shares their photographs, videos, voice messages, memories, feelings, special moments, wishes and poems with us.

We transform everything into a beautiful personalized website created specially for Kalaay. Then we convert the website into a QR code.

On Kalaay's birthday, Mani gives her the QR code.

She scans it.

The memories begin to appear. Their photos. Their story. Their favorite moments. His voice. His words. Their memories.

A simple scan becomes an unforgettable emotional experience.

And suddenly...

It is not just a website.

It is their story.

Create Their Moment

Wedding

More Than A Wedding Invitation.

A wedding invitation tells your guests where and when. But what if you could tell them your story too?

Your personalized wedding website can include:

Couple's storyEngagement memoriesWedding photosPre-wedding photosVideosVoice messagesFamily memoriesWedding wishesSpecial messagesImportant information

The QR code can be added to the wedding invitation. Guests simply scan it and experience the couple's beautiful journey.

Order Process

How To Place Your Order

Kindly place your order at least 10 days before your required delivery date.
01

Fill the Google Form

Select your plan and provide your celebration details and memories.

02

Contact Us on WhatsApp

After submitting the form, contact us through WhatsApp at 8531046561.

03

Order Confirmation

Our team will contact you and confirm your order.

04

We Create Your Website

Our team transforms your memories into your personalized website.

05

Delivery

We will deliver your completed website and QR code within 10 days.

After Order Confirmation

Once your order is confirmed, changes are not advisable because the website creation process begins immediately.

Any additional change or modification requested after order confirmation will be charged at ₹100 per change.
